reviews.text: Literally the best dog I’ve ever had in my life. Charlie has the sweetest tempermant and is so well behaved!  He is such a wonderful addition to our family. We couldnt be happier!

When my family meet John and his dogs we felt at home and in the right place.  John found the perfect service dog for my family.  His dogs are taken care of and you can tell that John loves what he does.  I can not thank him enough!!!

I’m so glad that I was able to find John at Hunters Creek Retrievers.  My family was in need of a service dog. We wanted a dog that was well trained at home as well as in public. When we went to meet John, we immediately knew we were in the right place. We learned about the mini charities that he has contributed to as well as working for the JJ Watt commercial. John’s dogs are not only well trained. They are very well behaved. Before our meeting, we told John what we were looking for. He introduced us to all of his dogs and then took us to the seven that he thought would be the best for us. Out of those my daughter was immediately drawn to one. My daughter worked with the seven dogs that John had pulled out for her. He was very patient and kind. My daughter asked John a lot of questions. He answered them and explained everything that she wanted to know. Our dog has been an amazing contribution to our family. He fit right in from the day we got him and has allowed my daughter to live a happy and healthy life. He has been very helpful regarding the budget that we had set and has answered any questions that we have had after we brought our dog home. Thank you John for giving my daughter the ability to live the life she wants.

John is an amzing person. He has helped my family in so many ways. First with a service dog for my baby sister who has severe disabling anxiety we got scout off of him and scout has not only helped her but it’s changed the whole family. I definitely recommend getting a dog from John!
Got a beautiful lab puppy on Memorial Day. He is maturing into a great pup smart well mannered loves to swim and retrieve

Got the sweetest, most loyal boy from Hunter’s Creek. The owner is knowledgeable, and wonderful to talk to. If you’re looking for good bloodlines for a family pet or even hunting dog, go to Hunter’s Creek.

John picked a puppy that will be trained to be a service dog for my daughter with several disabilities. It's only been a few weeks, but the puppy seems to be very eager to please and learn new things. Definitely a positive experience, even from about as far away in Texas as one can be from the Houston area!
